principle: This is the deliberate V0 census. New broad source research is frozen after this file unless a concrete project/category gap requires it. Candidate sources do not count as live coverage until access exists and a real Product Twin test passes.

freeze_rule: After this census, do not search broadly for more APIs. Only investigate a new source when an active Product Twin category/identity/geometry/logistics gap cannot be solved by the sources listed here.
